A microprocessor integrates the arithmetic logic unit (ALU) and control unit on a single chip, along with registers.  
- (B) is incorrect because memory (especially main memory) is typically external to the microprocessor chip.  
- (C) is incorrect because I/O devices are generally not integrated into the microprocessor itself.  
- (D) is incorrect because it omits the ALU, which is a core component of the microprocessor.  

Final answer: (A)
